brutalist.name: Brutalist / Béton Brut & Tectonic Honesty
brutalist.lineage: Alison & Peter Smithson (New Brutalism), Le Corbusier (La Tourette, Chandigarh), Louis Kahn (Salk Institute), Marcel Breuer
banham_criteria: 1. 1:1 Memorability of Image through stark volumetric geometry
2. Clear Exhibition of Structure and circulation infrastructure
3. Valuation of Materials 'as found' (béton brut, board-marked timber shuttering, raw steel, unplastered ashlar)
spatial_concepts: Stereotomic massing (heavy, earth-grounded, subtractive volumetric carving)
Honest joints (no decorative trim, visible tie-rod holes, expressed board shuttering seams)
Deep spatial reveals and monumental brise-soleil shadow play
Thermal mass inertia (diurnal heat storage in exposed concrete/stone)
brutalist.monograph_expression: Raw heavyweight typography (JetBrains Mono / Space Grotesk in high contrast), uncropped constructive 1:20 sections showing rebar placement and formwork ties, zero photographic glamour rendering, pure tectonic drawing.

tectonic_rationalist.name: Tectonic Rationalism / Swiss Ticino School
tectonic_rationalist.lineage: Livio Vacchini, Luigi Snozzi, Mario Botta, Aldo Rossi, Karl Gerstner
spatial_concepts: Hyper-calibrated geometric discipline and modular proportional rhythm
Clear articulation of the stereotomic base vs the tectonic frame
Mathematical Swiss grid alignment (8, 12, 16 columns) with strict baseline hierarchy
Tectonic joints as architectural poetry (calibrated hairlines 0.13mm to 0.50mm)
tectonic_rationalist.monograph_expression: Strict Swiss typography, baseline grid discipline, uncropped orthographic plans and sections, exact dimension strings, archival bone paper background.

phenomenological_minimalist.name: Phenomenological Minimalism & Material Atmosphere
phenomenological_minimalist.lineage: Peter Zumthor (Vals, Kolumba), Juhani Pallasmaa (The Eyes of the Skin), Alberto Campo Baeza, Sverre Fehn
spatial_concepts: Multi-sensory tactile engagement (temperature of stone, acoustic damping of mass timber)
Raking natural daylight revealing surface grain and micro-relief
Compression and release (the liminal threshold chamber before the monumental room)
Shadow reveals (joint creux) and silent transitions between floor, wall, and ceiling
phenomenological_minimalist.monograph_expression: Generous 40%+ white space breathing room, tactile material triptychs, micro-detailed 1:5 joinery reveals, evocative chiaroscuro lighting vectors.

critical_regionalist.name: Critical Regionalism & Bioclimatic Vernacular
critical_regionalist.lineage: Kenneth Frampton (Six Points for an Architecture of Resistance), Geoffrey Bawa, Glenn Murcutt, Studio Mumbai
spatial_concepts: Direct response to local microclimate, solar azimuth, and prevailing wind vectors
Authentic geological provenance (Breton granite, local lime-hemp biotamping)
Deep eaves and permeable tectonic screens protecting the envelope
Rejection of placeless corporate architecture in favor of tectonic site memory
critical_regionalist.monograph_expression: Solar vector diagrams, stack ventilation loops, material sourcing maps with quarry coordinates, environmental performance specs (U-value, carbon footprint).

structural_expressionist.name: High-Tech Structural Expressionism
structural_expressionist.lineage: Renzo Piano, Richard Rogers, Norman Foster, Peter Rice
spatial_concepts: Absolute legibility of structural forces (tension rods, compression struts, pin joints)
Kahnian articulation of Serviced vs Servant spaces (exposed MEP risers, separate circulation towers)
Prefabricated modular assembly and demountable dry joints
High-performance glazed envelopes with dynamic automated shading
structural_expressionist.monograph_expression: Exploded axonometrics, 1:10 cast-steel node details, engineering calculation tables, dynamic vector flow diagrams.

neoclassical.name: Neoclassicism & Palladian Order
neoclassical.lineage: Claude-Nicolas Ledoux, Étienne-Louis Boullée, Karl Friedrich Schinkel, Andrea Palladio, Vitruvius
spatial_concepts: Rigorous axial symmetry and hierarchical tripartite elevation (rusticated plinth base, piano nobile, attic)
Canonical classical orders (Doric, Ionic, Corinthian) and pedimented porticos
Monumental stereotomic massing with crisp stone entablatures and peristyles
Vitruvian triad: Firmitas (structural soundess), Utilitas (functional clarity), Venustas (proportional beauty)
neoclassical.monograph_expression: Centered monumental titles, symmetrical double-page spreads, hairline elevation engravings, stone ashlar joint lines, classical golden ratio modular division.

beaux_arts.name: Beaux-Arts & Monumental Hierarchy
beaux_arts.lineage: École des Beaux-Arts Paris, Charles Garnier (Opéra de Paris), Richard Morris Hunt, McKim, Mead & White
spatial_concepts: Clear architectural Parti Pris (the singular founding concept sketch)
The Marche: experiential choreographed sequence through grand vestibules, monument stairs, and rotunda
Monumental axial enfilades with rich sculptural cartouches and rusticated stone ashlar
Clear hierarchy of primary ceremonial spaces versus secondary servant zones
beaux_arts.monograph_expression: Lavish washed ink section cuts (poché), grand transverse sectional perspectives, richly annotated circulation pathways, monumental roman serifs paired with technical mono.

art_nouveau.name: Art Nouveau & Biomorphic Structural Tectonics
art_nouveau.lineage: Victor Horta (Hôtel Tassel), Hector Guimard, Antoni Gaudí (Modernisme), Henry van de Velde
spatial_concepts: Whiplash curves (coup de fouet) transforming structural iron into organic fluid stems
Total work of art (Gesamtkunstwerk) unifying structure, fenestration, lighting, and joinery
Exposed cast and wrought iron structural columns blooming into floral cantilever brackets
Dynamic biomorphic asymmetry and stained-glass daylight filtration
art_nouveau.monograph_expression: Fluid curvilinear border accents, organic 1:5 structural ironwork details, botanical circulation diagrams, warm bone paper with subtle vegetative filigree hairlines.

art_deco.name: Art Deco & Streamlined Geometric Modernism
art_deco.lineage: 1925 Exposition Internationale Paris, Jacques-Émile Ruhlmann, William Van Alen (Chrysler), Raymond Hood
spatial_concepts: Stepped ziggurat massing setbacks responding to urban daylight zoning
Geometric stylization: chevron, sunburst, zig-zag, and vertical speedline motifs
Luxurious material triptychs: polished black Belgian granite, brushed satin brass, exotic macassar ebony
Streamlined verticality with recessed vertical fenestration spandrel panels
art_deco.monograph_expression: Stepped geometric framing borders, high-contrast graphite typography, metallic brass accent callouts, 1:5 millwork details of bespoke brass inlays and exotic veneer graining.

sensory_scenography.name: Ephemeral Scenography & Olfactory Architecture
sensory_scenography.hero_concept: Designing for the invisible: air, memory, mist, and the dialectic between monumental landscape and temporary textile intervention.
sensory_scenography.historical_lineage: Yasmine Chouchane (Atelier Adeline), Christo and Jeanne-Claude (The Gates, Running Fence), Robert Smithson (Spiral Jetty), Peter Zumthor (Swiss Sound Pavilion Expo 2000).
signature_features: Raw stone vs soft fabric contrasts
Mirrored stainless steel dissolving into desert rocks
Draped sensory isolation chambers with atomized mist
Negative space restraint (knowing when to stop designing)
critique_rubric: Does the intervention justify its presence in the landscape?
Is the spatial choreography designed around an emotional sequence rather than decorative objects?
Does the reflection capture and honor the context rather than distracting from it?

indic_spatial_systems.name: Indic Spatial Systems & Vāstu Tectonics
indic_spatial_systems.hero_concept: Cosmic geometry, perceptual continuum, and climate-responsive courtyard morphology rooted in ancient treatises and modern collective intelligence.
indic_spatial_systems.historical_lineage: Balkrishna Doshi (Sangath, Aranya), Charles Correa (Jawahar Kala Kendra, Gandhi Smarak Sangrahalaya), Raj Rewal (Asian Games Village, Parliament Library), Pearl Gupta (Aayojan).
signature_features: 9-square Vāstu-Purusha mandala matrix
Deep sandstone jali screens and shaded colonnades
Perceptual continuum between mind, space, and form
100-year aggregate institutional spatial frameworks
critique_rubric: Is the mandala geometry integrated tectonically or applied purely as a 2D diagram?
How does the courtyard typology perform under peak thermal solar gain?
Are the materials quarried regionally with authentic stereotomic joinery?

deconstructivism.name: Deconstructivism & Non-Euclidean Geometry
deconstructivism.hero_concept: Fractured planes, non-rectilinear volumes, skewed axes, and kinetic tension that challenges conventional Cartesian spatial assumptions.
deconstructivism.historical_lineage: Zaha Hadid (Vitra Fire Station), Daniel Libeskind (Jewish Museum Berlin), Peter Eisenman (Wexner Center), Bernard Tschumi (Parc de la Villette).
signature_features: Non-rectilinear fragmented geometries and cantilevers
Skewed structural axes and non-Euclidean folding
Titanium, zinc, and structural steel moment frames
Defiance of traditional floor-wall-ceiling demarcations
critique_rubric: Are the expressive cantilevers structurally verified through moment connection details?
Does the geometric complexity serve a clear spatial program or devolve into arbitrary sculptural form?
How are thermal bridges avoided at acute angular envelope junctions?

japandi_wabi_sabi.name: Japandi Hybrid & Wabi-Sabi Tectonics
japandi_wabi_sabi.hero_concept: The beauty of imperfection, acoustic stillness, and the harmonious synthesis of Scandinavian functionalism with traditional Japanese joinery.
japandi_wabi_sabi.historical_lineage: Kengo Kuma (Asakusa Culture Tourist Center), Tadao Ando (Church of the Light), Axel Vervoordt (Kanaal, Triennale di Venezia).
signature_features: Muted organic palette and hand-troweled lime plasters
Charred timber (shou sugi ban) and hinoki cypress joinery
Acoustic damping through washi paper and woven rushes
Negative space (Ma) celebrated as a primary spatial element
critique_rubric: Does the project demonstrate genuine material craft or superficial aesthetic staging?
How does natural daylight interact with textured matte surfaces across diurnal cycles?
Are millwork reveals and hidden hardware engineered with precise tolerance gaps?

haussmannian_classicism.name: Haussmannian Classicism & French Boiserie
haussmannian_classicism.hero_concept: Rigorous urban facade rhythm, high-ceiling piano nobile proportions, chevron parquet, and bespoke integrated boiserie millwork.
haussmannian_classicism.historical_lineage: Baron Haussmann (Paris Urban Renovation 1853–1870), Henri Labrouste (Bibliothèque Sainte-Geneviève), Pierre Yovanovitch, Christian Liaigre.
signature_features: Point de Hongrie (chevron) solid French oak parquet
Carved marble mantels (cheminée trumeau) and molded plaster cornices
Concealed flush pivot doors and full-height boiserie cabinetry
High-contrast tactile triptychs (black Saint-Laurent marble, linen, oak)
critique_rubric: Are historical architectural mouldings aligned with contemporary structural interventions?
Does the spatial layout respect classic enfilade sightlines while accommodating modern egress?
Are bespoke joinery details specified at 1:5 scale with verified hardware clearances?
